messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The figure stands with her back to the camera, raises her right hand to touch her head, places her left hand on her hip, and then shifts her weight and turns slightly to her right.","camera":"A static, medium-full shot from behind the subject at a slightly low angle.","clothing":"A short, blue and white patterned dress with a low open back and three-quarter sleeves, paired with red sneakers.","hair_color":"Unclear, as the hair is completely covered by a white head wrap.","hairstyle":"Hair is fully covered by a white head wrap or turban.","identity":"A slender, dark-skinned female figure with a slim build, shown from behind.","scene":"A futuristic, wet outdoor plaza with a large glass building featuring glowing green circular neon lights and pink structural accents in the background."},"uncertain":["hair_color"]}}

arguments.observed_change: The amusement park background was replaced with the reference's futuristic glass building, green circular neon lights, pink accents, and wet reflective plaza. The person remains in a similar rear medium-full framing and performs the same head-touching/hip pose sequence, with lighting now cooler and more reflective.
arguments.requested_change: Change the scene to the futuristic wet plaza shown in the reference, keeping the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged, preserving camera framing/movement and adapting lighting to the new environment.
uncertain: Hair color cannot be verified because the head wrap covers the hair in both videos.
Whether the darker skin tone is an intended lighting adaptation or an unintended identity change cannot be fully determined.
unexpected_changes: The person's skin tone appears noticeably darker in the output than in the source, which may be due to lighting adaptation but is a visible identity/appearance change.
